Crypto makes the recipient work first. CashDrop flips it.

THE USUAL WAY
  1. They install a wallet
  2. They write down a seed phrase
  3. They find the right address
  4. They send it back to you
  5. You check the network and address type
  6. Finally, you pay
Six steps, and the person you are paying does five of them.
WITH CASHDROP
  1. You seal an amount
  2. You send the link
  3. They claim it, whenever they are ready
The money is already waiting before they ever open a wallet.
HOW IT WORKS

A one-time envelope, sealed on your device.

01
Seal

CashDrop creates a fresh, single-use shielded envelope locally. You fund it from any Zcash wallet with a normal shielded payment.

02
Send

You get a claim link and a QR card. Share it the way you already talk: an encrypted chat, a printed card, a note in person.

03
Claim

They open it, see the amount verified on-chain, and move it into their own shielded wallet. The envelope is empty after that.

Changed your mind? Until it is claimed, you can take the money back. If you both try at once, the first transaction confirmed on-chain wins.
PRIVACY

The chain sees a shielded transaction. That’s it.

Zcash’s shielded pool does the hiding. CashDrop’s job is to make sure your money never leaves it, and that nothing about the drop ever touches our servers.

We never receive the claim secret, keys, amount, note or address
No analytics, no trackers, no third-party scripts
No accounts, so there is nothing to link to you
